entries.text: Hello, everyone. It’s a pleasure to meet all of you\nBlueberry students.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_first_00

entries.text: My name’s Tyme, and I hope we can all enjoy\nlearning together.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_first_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Here you are, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I’d
heard
the
talk
about
you
going
to
study
at
Blueberry
Academy.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_00

entries.text: You’ve certainly been working hard, haven’t you?\nEven becoming a Champion here![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_01

entries.text: You’ve really made me proud, doing such\noutstanding work.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_02

entries.text: Please feel free to call on me any time you’d like\nto borrow me or ask for a bit of help.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_03

entries.text: Help, Ms. Tyme!
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_select_01

entries.text: You bet I will!
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_select_02

entries.text: You already want my help with something?\nGoodness, you are a funny one![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_04

entries.text: Well, I like that enthusiasm! I’ll be excited to\nhear from you![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_04b

entries.text: I’m sure you’ve got plenty to juggle with your\nclub and your adventures, but don’t forget to\r\noccasionally hit the books as well![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp01_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Pop-quiz time, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! How
about
a
little
review
problem
from
me
to you?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_00

entries.text: What percent chance does a Pokémon usually\nhave to land a critical hit?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_01

entries.text: About 1 percent
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_select_01

entries.text: About 4 percent
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_select_02

entries.text: About 12 percent
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_select_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, my. That’s close, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
Very
close.\c
But I’m afraid the right answer is about 4 percent.
Do your best to remember it now![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_02

entries.text: Well done! I knew I could count on you for this\nquestion, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nYou’ve really absorbed the material, haven’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_02b

entries.text: I have to admit...I’m a bit worried about the\nstudents here at Blueberry Academy.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_03

entries.text: So much of their coursework is made up of\nbattle studies and the like...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_04

entries.text: That’s all well and good for the children who\nhope to make a living doing that sort of thing.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_05

entries.text: But not every dream can come true. What if you\nshut the door to other paths you could take?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_06

entries.text: Mathematics, home economics, languages...\nYoung people need to know all these things\r\nto be ready for any kind of future.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_07

entries.text: I don’t think that any learning is truly wasted.\nYou never know what skills you’ll need.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_08

entries.text: Oh, I’m sorry for talking your ear off, though.\nI didn’t mean to go on like that...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_09

entries.text: It’s totally fine!
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_select_04

entries.text: It was good to hear!
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_select_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Goodness, you are a sweet child! Thank you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Hearing that from
you
makes
me
feel
like
I
can
keep
on going![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp02_10

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I have to thank you again,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
for
listening
to
this
old
woman
gripe
last time.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp03_00

entries.text:
After that talk, I went straight to the director here
and I told him what was on my mind.\c
I said flat out that he needed to offer a more
diverse curriculum than just battle studies.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp03_01

entries.text: And how did it go?
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp03_select_01

entries.text: I knew you had it in you!
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp03_select_02

entries.text: While he won’t be changing the base curriculum,\nhe DID say he had no problem at all with offering\r\nmore subjects as electives![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp03_02

entries.text:
In fact, he said that was part of his motivation
behind having you do all this!\c
You know, calling folks like me to visit his school
and serve as coaches![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp03_03

entries.text:
And there I’d gone, getting ahead of myself
thinking I needed to start some sort of
educational reform!\c
My, it’s a bit embarrassing now that I know better.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp03_04

entries.text:
I may not have a lot of takers yet for my math
class, but I’ll keep it up and grow our numbers!\c
Put in a good word for me with your friends here,
won’t you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_sp03_05

entries.text: I’ve got to admit, getting off the warpath has\nsomehow taken the wind from my sails.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_trade_01_00

entries.text: I need some new excitement to really pick up my\nmood again.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_trade_01_01

entries.text: Oh, I know! How about you and I do a Pokémon\ntrade, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_trade_01_02

entries.text: There’s nothing to be lost in asking, right? Haha!\c\nI’ll offer up a Rockruff. What do you say to that,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]? Anything for me?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]This [VAR 0x0101(0001)] is just the ticket! I feel
better
already!\c
Thank you for the trade. I’ll be sure to treasure
your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] and raise it with care.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_math_trade_01_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So you’ll trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for my\nRockruff,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: coach_teacher_math_trade_02_02

You’ve got to have at least two, or I couldn’t
